option_relations.rationale: Age-related cardiac conduction disease is a broader category that can encompass specific conduction system diseases like the one described in the leaf.
Complete heart block (Third-degree AV block) is a specific type of conduction system disease that can lead to cardiac syncope.
Third-degree atrioventricular block is a specific type of conduction system disease that can lead to cardiac syncope.
Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block) is a specific type of conduction system disease that can lead to cardiac syncope.
